arxiv-1512-09340.title: Strict Doubly Ergodic Infinite Transformations
arxiv-1512-09340.creator: Isaac Loh, Cesar E. Silva
arxiv-1512-09340.description: Abstract . We give examples of rank-one transformations that are (weak) doubly ergodic and rigid (so all their cartesian products are conservative), but with non-ergodic 2 2 -fold cartesian product. We give conditions for rank-one infinite measure-preserving transformations to be (weak) doubly ergodic and for their k k -fold cartesian product to be conservative.

arxiv-2101-11780.title: A characterization of constant p p -mean curvature surfaces in the Heisenberg group H 1 H_{1}
arxiv-2101-11780.creator: Hung-Lin Chiu and Hsiao-Fan Liu
arxiv-2101-11780.description: Abstract . In Euclidean 3 3 -space, it is well known that the Sine-Gordon equation was considered in the nineteenth century in the course of investigations of surfaces of constant Gaussian curvature K = − 1 K=-1 . Such a surface can be constructed from a solution to the Sine-Gordon equation, and vice versa.

arxiv-2405-06345.title: Evaluating Adversarial Robustness in the Spatial Frequency Domain
arxiv-2405-06345.creator: Keng-Hsin Liao, Chin-Yuan Yeh, Hsi-Wen Chen, Ming-Syan Chen
arxiv-2405-06345.description: Abstract Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) have dominated the majority of computer vision tasks. However, CNNs’ vulnerability to adversarial attacks has raised concerns about deploying these models to safety-critical applications. In contrast, the Human Visual System (HVS), which utilizes spatial frequency channels to process visual signals, is immune to adversarial attacks.

arxiv-2410-17662.title: Special Lagrangian submanifolds in K3-fibered Calabi-Yau 3-folds
arxiv-2410-17662.creator: Shih-Kai Chiu, Yu-Shen Lin
arxiv-2410-17662.description: Abstract . We construct special Lagrangian submanifolds in collapsing Calabi-Yau 3 3 -folds fibered by K3 surfaces. As these 3 3 -folds collapse, the special Lagrangians shrink to 1 1 -dimensional graphs in the base, mirroring the conjectured tropicalization of holomorphic curves in collapsing SYZ torus-fibered Calabi-Yau manifolds. This confirms predictions of Donaldson and Donaldson-Scaduto in the Calabi-Yau setting.

arxiv-2501-05640.title: Automating Date Format Detection for Data Visualization
arxiv-2501-05640.creator: Zixuan Liang
arxiv-2501-05640.description: Abstract Data preparation, specifically date parsing, is a significant bottleneck in analytic workflows. To address this, we present two algorithms—one based on minimum entropy and the other on natural language modeling—that automatically derive date formats from string data. These algorithms achieve over 90% accuracy on a large corpus of data columns, streamlining the data preparation process within visualization environments.

arxiv-2509-11407.title: Pulse-to-Circuit Characterization of Stealthy Crosstalk Attack on Multi-Tenant Superconducting Quantum Hardware Conference: Proceedings of the 2025 Quantum Security and Privacy Workshop; October 13–17, 2025; Taipei, Taiwan Proceedings of the 2025 Quantum Security and Privacy Workshop (QSec ’25), Oct
arxiv-2509-11407.creator: Syed Emad Uddin Shubha, Tasnuva Farheen Division of Computer Science, Louisiana State University
arxiv-2509-11407.description: Abstract . Hardware crosstalk in multi-tenant superconducting quantum computers constitutes a significant security threat, enabling adversaries to inject targeted errors across tenant boundaries. We present the first end-to-end framework for mapping physical pulse-level attacks to interpretable logical error channels, integrating density-matrix simulation, quantum process tomography (QPT), and a novel isometry-based circuit extraction method.

pmc-11551294.title: Disparities in mortality rates from aortic aneurysm and dissection by country-level income status and sex
pmc-11551294.creator: Makoto Hibino, Nitish K. Dhingra, Raj Verma, Christoph A. Nienaber, Bobby Yanagawa, Subodh Verma
pmc-11551294.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). ObjectiveTo investigate the impact of national income level and sex on mortality trends from aortic aneurysm and dissection in addition to all aortic disease as a whole.MethodsUsing data from the World Health Organization mortality database, we conducted an analysis of mortality trends from aortic disease between 2000 and 2019, Countries were categorized into middle-income and high-income countries (MICs and HICs) on the basis of income level. Age-standardized and sex-specific age-standardized mortality rates per 100,000 persons, along with male-to-female mortality ratios, were calculated.

pmc-11657536.creator: Jesús Froylán Martínez-Puc, Miguel Ángel Magaña-Magaña, William Cetzal-Ix, Gustavo E. Mendoza-Arroyo, Ángel Carmelo Sierra-Vasquez, Saikat Kumar Basu
pmc-11657536.description: BackgroundMeliponiculture is the breeding of stingless bees (SB) or bees of the Meliponini tribe. In Mexico, this activity was practiced before the arrival of the Spaniards, with the Yucatan Peninsula (YP) (comprising the states of Campeche, Quintana Roo and Yucatan) being the most important region due to its link with the economic, cultural and medicinal aspects of the Mayan communities.

pmc-11673219.title: Deep-Learning Model for Mortality Prediction of ICU Patients with Paralytic Ileus
pmc-11673219.creator: Martha Razo, Maryam Pishgar, William Galanter, Houshang Darabi, Jinshan Tang, Sos Agaian
pmc-11673219.description: Paralytic Ileus (PI) patients in the Intensive Care Unit (ICU) face a significant risk of death. Current predictive models for PI are often complex and rely on many variables, resulting in unreliable outcomes for such a serious health condition. Predicting mortality in ICU patients with PI is particularly challenging due to the vast amount of data and numerous features involved.

pmc-12611155.description: Dementia prevalence across the globe is in alarming proportion and it is even expected to rise in the future. pmc-13009250.title: Development and preclinical results of a transcatheter aortic valve implant with novel polymeric leaflets
pmc-13009250.creator: J Ryan Stanfield, Garrett Johnson, Nelson Belais, Isaac George, Steven Yakubov
pmc-13009250.description: Current transcatheter aortic valve implantation (TAVI) systems use glutaraldehyde-fixed tissue leaflets, which are prone to structural valve degeneration. Polymeric valves may improve durability, hemocompatibility, and manufacturability. We designed, produced, and evaluated a self-expanding nitinol-framed TAVI device with siloxane poly(urethane-urea) (SiPUU) leaflets and an electrospun SiPUU skirt.

pmc-13627021.creator: Daiping Hua, Shang Xiang, Xianfeng Yu, Jingjing Wu, Yequn Wang, Wenming Yang, Han Wang
pmc-13627021.description: Pseudohypoparathyroidism (PHP) type 1A is a rare inherited disorder characterized by resistance to parathyroid hormone and, typically, features of Albright hereditary osteodystrophy. We report a late-onset case in a 59-year-old woman who presented with cognitive decline, behavioral and psychiatric symptoms, gait instability, and seizure-like episodes. Laboratory tests showed hypocalcemia, hyperphosphatemia, and elevated parathyroid hormone levels.
